content: Emails » View Contacts Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000048447 In this section the contacts that have been added to the site through various forms are stored: Search and filter through these contacts by: 1. Name 2. Email Address 3. Form Submitted Within " Actions " there is a set of actions: 1. Edit 2. Email 3. Delete When editing there are 6 different sections to add or edit various information: Click on Save Changes , to have all of the contact information saved properly in the system. Export Contacts The Contacts can be exported by hovering over the Contact List Actions - Export Results: Important note : this functionality is part of the Export Member Data addon: Export Member Data For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
